questions.stem: 设  \( \lim_{x\to\infty}f'(x)=0 \)  ，且  \( \lim_{x\to\infty}\left(\frac{ax^{2}}{1+x}-bx-1\right)=\lim_{x\to\infty}[f(x+1)-f(x)] \)  ，则曲线  \( y=\frac{ax^{2}}{1+x} \)  的斜渐近线方程为

solution.analysis_md:
由拉格朗日中值定理,有
\[
f (x + 1) - f (x) = f ^ {\prime} (\xi), \quad x <   \xi <   x + 1
\]
当 \(x \to \infty\) 时, \(\xi \to \infty\), 故
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} [ f (x + 1) - f (x) ] = \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow \infty} f ^ {\prime} (\xi) = 0
\]
由 \(\lim_{x\to \infty}\left(\frac{ax^2}{1 + x} -bx - 1\right) = \lim_{x\to \infty}\frac{(a - b)x^2 - (b + 1)x - 1}{1 + x} = 0\)
得 \(a - b = 0, b + 1 = 0\)，故 \(a = -1, b = -1\).
由 \(\lim_{x\to \infty}\left(\frac{ax^2}{1 + x} -bx - 1\right) = \lim_{x\to \infty}\left[\frac{-x^2}{1 + x} -(-x + 1)\right] = 0\) ，知 \(y = \frac{ax^2}{1 + x} = \frac{-x^2}{1 + x}\) 的斜渐近线方程为 \(y = -x + 1\)
A 正确.

questions.stem: 设可导函数 \( f(x) \) 在 \([a, b]\) 上满足 \( f(x) > 0, f'(x) > 0 \)，则 \(\lim_{b \to a^+} \frac{\ln f(b) - \ln f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)} =\)

solution.analysis_md:
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {b \rightarrow a ^ {+}} \frac {\ln f (b) - \ln f (a)}{f (b) - f (a)} = \lim _ {b \rightarrow a ^ {+}} \frac {\ln f (b) - \ln f (a)}{b - a} \cdot \frac {b - a}{f (b) - f (a)} \\ = \lim _ {b \rightarrow a ^ {+}} \frac {\ln f (b) - \ln f (a)}{b - a} \cdot \lim _ {b \rightarrow a ^ {+}} \frac {b - a}{f (b) - f (a)} \\ = \frac {f _ {+} ^ {\prime} (a)}{f (a)} \cdot \frac {1}{f _ {+} ^ {\prime} (a)} = \frac {1}{f (a)} \\ \end{array}
\]
B 正确.

questions.stem: 设 \(I_{1} = \int_{0}^{1} \ln (1 + x) \mathrm{d}x, I_{2} = \int_{0}^{1} \frac{\arctan x}{1 + x} \mathrm{d}x, I_{3} = \int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{\ln (1 + x)} \mathrm{d}x\)，则

solution.analysis_md:
在 \([0,1]\) 上，\(0 \leqslant \ln (1 + x) \leqslant \ln 2 < 1\)，故
\[
\ln (1 + x) \leqslant \sqrt {\ln (1 + x)}
\]
从而 \(I_{1} < I_{3}\)
令 \(f(x) = \ln (1 + x) - \frac{\arctan x}{1 + x}\) ，则
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {1}{1 + x} - \frac {1}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \cdot \left(\frac {1 + x}{1 + x ^ {2}} - \arctan x\right) = \frac {(1 + x) x ^ {2} + (1 + x ^ {2}) \arctan x}{(1 + x) ^ {2} (1 + x ^ {2})}
\]
当 \(x \in [0,1]\) 时，\(f'(x) \geqslant 0\)，故 \(f(x)\) 单调增加；又 \(f(0) = 0\)，所以 \(f(x) \geqslant f(0) = 0\)，即
\[
\ln (1 + x) \geqslant \frac {\arctan x}{1 + x}, \quad x \in [ 0, 1 ]
\]
从而 \(I_{1} > I_{2}\). 综上所述, \(I_{3} > I_{1} > I_{2}\), A 正确.

questions.stem: 设 \(z(x, y)\) 满足 \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \sin y + \frac{1}{1 - xy}, z(1, y) = \sin y\), 则

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \sin y + \frac{1}{1 - xy}\), 有 \(z_x'(0,2) = \sin 2 + 1\), 且
\[
z = \int \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \mathrm{d} x + \varphi (y) = x \sin y - \frac {1}{y} \ln | 1 - x y | + \varphi (y)
\]
当 \(x = 1\) 时，由 \(z(1,y) = \sin y - \frac{1}{y}\ln |1 - y| + \varphi (y) = \sin y\) ，得 \(\varphi (y) = \frac{1}{y}\ln |1 - y|\) ，故
\[
z = x \sin y - \frac {1}{y} \ln | 1 - x y | + \frac {1}{y} \ln | 1 - y |
\]
令 \(x = 0, z(0, y) = \frac{1}{y} \ln |1 - y|\)，故
\[
z _ {y} ^ {\prime} (0, 2) = \left[ - \frac {1}{y ^ {2}} \ln | 1 - y | + \frac {1}{y} \cdot \frac {1}{1 - y} \cdot (- 1) \right] \Bigg | _ {y = 2} = \frac {1}{2}
\]
所以 \(\mathrm{d}z|_{(0,2)} = (1 + \sin 2)\mathrm{d}x + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{d}y.\)
C 正确.

由已知, \( x_{n}>0 \) ,则
\[
\sqrt {\frac {x _ {n + 1}}{x _ {n}}} \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \left(x _ {n + 1} + \frac {1}{x _ {n}}\right) <   1 (n = 1, 2, \dots) \tag {①}
\]
故 \(\{x_{n}\}\) 单调递减，有下界 \(0, \lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\) 存在.
记 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = A\) ，则 \(A > 0\) （见“注”），式 ① 取极限 \((n\to \infty)\) ，有 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\sqrt{\frac{x_{n + 1}}{x_n}} = \sqrt{\frac{A}{A}} = 1.\)
由夹逼准则,有  \( \lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{2}\left(x_{n+1}+\frac{1}{x_n}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(A+\frac{1}{A}\right)=1 \)
解得 A = 1，即 B 正确。
【注】若 \(A = 0, x_{n+1} + \frac{1}{x_n} < 2\)，两边取极限 \((n \to \infty)\)，有 \(+\infty \leqslant 2\)，矛盾。故 \(A > 0\)。

questions.stem:
设 \( f(x) \) 在 \([0,4]\) 上有二阶连续导数，在 \( xOy \) 坐标系中，三条曲线为 \( y = f(x), y = f'(x), y = f''(x) \). 如图所示，则 \( y = f(x) \) 在 \([0,4]\) 上

![](/uploads/books/c36e62cf2f41636ea191aa6b6e90ad0f9f8ec060e3713f3355262cd94f840554.jpg)

options.A: 有一个极值点,一个拐点.
options.B: 有一个极值点,两个拐点.
options.C: 有两个极值点,一个拐点.
options.D: 有两个极值点,两个拐点.

solution.analysis_md:
先根据 \( y = f(x), y = f'(x), y = f''(x) \) 的正负号判别题图中的曲线哪一条是 \( y = f(x) \).
若 \( y = f(x) \) 为 \( L_{3} \)，则其图形上凸部分对应 \( y = f''(x) < 0 \)，因而 \( y = f''(x) \) 相应部分位于 \( x \) 轴下方，从题图中可知 \( L_{1} \) 正是这种情形.
又由 \( y = f''(x) < 0 \)，知 \( y = f'(x) \) 在对应区间上单调递减，\( L_2 \) 正是该情形，故 \( L_1, L_2, L_3 \) 分别为 \( y = f''(x), y = f'(x), y = f(x) \).
从题图中可以看出, \( y = f(x) \) 在 \( x = 1, x = 3 \) 分别取得极大值与极小值, 点(2,0)为拐点. C 正确.

questions.stem: 已知平面上的点 \(A(0,1)\) 和抛物线 \(x = 2\sqrt{y}\), 动点 \(P\) 从坐标原点 \(O\) 出发, 沿抛物线移动, 若直线段 \(OA\)、\(AP\) 和抛物线所围成图形的面积对时间 \(t\) 的增大速率为 1 , 则当 \(P\) 移动到点 (6,9) 处时, \(P\) 的横坐标的变动速率为

solution.analysis_md:
如图所示,设动点  \( P(X,Y) \) , 则 AP 的方程为
\[
y - 1 = \frac {Y - 1}{X} (x - 0)
\]
因 \(Y = \frac{1}{4} X^2\) ，故 \(AP\) 的方程为
\[
y = \left(\frac {X}{4} - \frac {1}{X}\right) x + 1
\]
则面积为
![](/uploads/books/857afcd49ff1a43cf60753c160b1f91c2756593c15596fec09298f0aef3fb493.jpg)
\[
S = \int_ {0} ^ {X} \left[ \left(\frac {X}{4} - \frac {1}{X}\right) x + 1 - \frac {x ^ {2}}{4} \right] \mathrm{d} x = \frac {X ^ {3}}{2 4} + \frac {X}{2}
\]
又 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}S}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}S}{\mathrm{d}X} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}X}{\mathrm{d}t} = \left(\frac{X^2}{8} + \frac{1}{2}\right)\frac{\mathrm{d}X}{\mathrm{d}t} = 1\)，故 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}X}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{8}{X^2 + 4}\)，于是 \(\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}X}{\mathrm{d}t}\right|_{X=6} = \frac{1}{5}\). D 正确.

options.B: \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解均是 \(AX = 0\) 的解, 但二者不同解.
options.C: \(AX = 0\) 的解均是 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解, 但二者不同解.
options.D: \(AX = 0\) 与 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 没有非零公共解.

solution.analysis_md:
记 \(B = (\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3})\)，则
\[
\boldsymbol {B} = \left[ \begin{array}{r r r} 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 1 \\ - 2 & - 1 & a \end{array} \right] \rightarrow \left[ \begin{array}{r r r} 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & - 3 & - 1 \\ 0 & 3 & a + 2 \end{array} \right] \rightarrow \left[ \begin{array}{r r r} 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & - 3 & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & a + 1 \end{array} \right]
\]
由 \(a \neq -1\), 知 \(r(B) = 3\), 故 \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}\) 线性无关, 从而 \(\alpha_{1} - \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{2} - \alpha_{3}\) 是对应齐次线性方程组 \(AX = 0\) 的两个线性无关解, 于是 \(r(A) \leqslant 1\); 但 \(A \neq O\), 故 \(r(A) \geqslant 1\), 所以 \(r(A) = 1\). 从而 \(r(A^{*}) = 0, A^{*} = O\), 所以任意 3 维列向量均是 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解.
因此, \(AX = 0\) 的解均是 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解, 选项 C 正确. 选项 B 不正确, 选项 A 不正确.
对于选项 D, 由 AX = 0 的基础解系至少包含两个解向量, 知 AX = 0 有无穷多个非零解. 从而 AX = 0 与  \( A^{*}X = 0 \)  的公共解中有无穷多个非零解. 选项 D 不正确.
【注】若 \(A = O\) ，则 \(AX = b (b \neq 0)\) 无解，与已知条件矛盾，故 \(A \neq O\)

questions.stem: 设 \(A\) 为 2 阶实矩阵, \(\alpha\) 与 \(\beta\) 是 \(A\) 的两个单位实特征向量, 且满足 \(||\alpha + \beta|| = ||\alpha - \beta||\), 则

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(\| \alpha +\beta \| = \| \alpha -\beta \|\) ，知 \(\| \alpha +\beta \| ^2 = \| \alpha -\beta \| ^2\) ，即
\[
(\alpha + \beta , \alpha + \beta) = (\alpha - \beta , \alpha - \beta)
\]
故 \((\alpha + \beta)^{\mathrm{T}}(\alpha + \beta) = (\alpha - \beta)^{\mathrm{T}}(\alpha - \beta)\)
即 \(\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha +\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta +\beta^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha +\beta^{\mathrm{T}}\beta = \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha -\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta -\beta^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha +\beta^{\mathrm{T}}\beta\)
也即 \(2(\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta +\beta^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha) = 0\) ，而 \(\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta = \beta^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha\) ，故 \(4\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta = 0.\)
从而 \(\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta = 0\) ，所以 \(\alpha\) 与 \(\beta\) 正交(垂直)，于是知 \(A\) 是2阶实对称矩阵，从而 \(A\) 必相似于对角矩阵. C正确. 由于 \(A\) 的特征值未知，故A、B、D不正确.
【注】令 \(Q = (\alpha, \beta)\), 则 \(Q\) 为正交矩阵, 使得
\[
Q ^ {- 1} A Q = \Lambda = \operatorname{diag} (\lambda_ {1}, \lambda_ {2})
\]
从而  \( A = Q \Lambda Q^{-1}, A^{T} = (Q^{-1})^{T} A^{T} Q^{T} = Q \Lambda Q^{-1} = A \) ，故 A 是对称矩阵.

questions.stem: 设 \(A, B, C\) 均为 3 阶矩阵, \(r(C) = 1\), \(r(B) = 2\), 且满足 \((A + E)C = O, B(A^T - 2E) = O\), 则下列矩阵中与 \(A\) 相似的是

solution.analysis_md:
解: 由 \(r(C) = 1, (A + E)C = O\), 知 \(C\) 的列向量是 \((A + E)X = 0\) 的解, 且至少有一个线性无关的解向量, 即 \(A\) 有特征值 \(\lambda = -1\).
对  \( \boldsymbol{B}(\boldsymbol{A}^{\mathrm{T}}-2\boldsymbol{E})=\boldsymbol{O} \)  两边同时取转置, 得
\[
\left[ \boldsymbol {A} - (2 \boldsymbol {E}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \right] \boldsymbol {B} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = (\boldsymbol {A} - 2 \boldsymbol {E}) \boldsymbol {B} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \boldsymbol {O}
\]
由 \(\mathrm{r}(\pmb{B}^{\mathrm{T}}) = \mathrm{r}(\pmb{B}) = 2\) ，知 \(\pmb{B}^{\mathrm{T}}\) 的列向量是 \((\pmb{A} - 2\pmb{E})\pmb{X} = \pmb{0}\) 的解，且至少有两个线性无关的解向量，即 \(\pmb{A}\) 有特征值 \(\lambda = 2\) ，且至少为二重根.
又 \(\mathrm{r}(\pmb {C}) + \mathrm{r}(\pmb {B}) = 3\) ，故 \(\lambda = -1\) 是单根， \(\lambda = 2\) 是二重根，从而 \(\mathbf{A}\sim \left[ \begin{array}{ccc} - 1 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & 2 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{array} \right].\) D正确.

questions.stem: 设 \( y = f(x) \) 由方程 \( \mathrm{e}^{y} + x = e\cos(xy) \) 确定，则 \( \lim_{n\to \infty}\left[f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)\right]^{n\left(1 - \cos \frac{1}{n}\right)} = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
已知方程 \( e^{y} + x = e\cos(xy) \)，当 \( x = 0 \) 时，\( y = 1 \)，即 \( f(0) = 1 \).
上述方程两边对 \(x\) 求导, 有
\[
\mathrm{e} ^ {y} \cdot y ^ {\prime} + 1 = - \mathrm{e} (y + x y ^ {\prime}) \sin (x y)
\]
将 \(x = 0, y = 1\) 代入上式，有
\[
y ^ {\prime} (0) = f ^ {\prime} (0) = - \frac {1}{\mathrm{e}}
\]
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ f \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right] ^ {\frac {1}{n (1 - \cos \frac {1}{n})}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{n (1 - \cos \frac {1}{n})} \ln f (\frac {1}{n})}
\]
又 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n\left(1 - \cos\frac{1}{n}\right)}\ln f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) = \lim_{n\to \infty}2n\ln f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) = 2\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{\ln f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) - \ln f(0)}{\frac{1}{n}}\)
\[
= 2 \left[ \ln f (x) \right] ^ {\prime} \mid_ {x = 0} = \frac {2 f ^ {\prime} (0)}{f (0)} = - \frac {2}{\mathrm{e}}
\]
故原式 \(= \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}}}\).

questions.stem:
设 \(x = f(y)\) 是单调可导函数 \(y = g(x)\) 的反函数, 且 \(g(1) = 2, g'(1) = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\), 则
\[
\lim _ {y \to 2} (y - 2) \frac {f (y) - f (2)}{(\ln y - \ln 2) ^ {2}} = \underline {{{\quad}}}.
\]

solution.analysis_md:
当 \(x = 1\) 时, \(y = g(1) = 2\), 由 \(x = f(y)\) 为 \(y = g(x)\) 的反函数, 知 \(f'(y) = \frac{1}{g'(x)}\), 故
\[
f ^ {\prime} (2) = \frac {1}{g ^ {\prime} (1)} = - \frac {3}{\sqrt {3}} = - \sqrt {3}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {y \rightarrow 2} (y - 2) \frac {f (y) - f (2)}{(\ln y - \ln 2) ^ {2}} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 2} \frac {f (y) - f (2)}{y - 2} \cdot \frac {(y - 2) ^ {2}}{(\ln y - \ln 2) ^ {2}} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (2) \lim _ {y \rightarrow 2} \frac {(y - 2) ^ {2}}{\left[ \ln \left(1 + \frac {y}{2} - 1\right)\right] ^ {2}} \\ = 4 f ^ {\prime} (2) = - 4 \sqrt {3} \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(a^2 + b^2 = 1 (a < 0, b > 0)\), 则曲线 \(y = x^2 + ax\) 与直线 \(y = bx\) 所围区域面积的最大值为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\( y = x^{2} + ax \) 与 \( y = bx \) 所围区域的面积为
\[
S = \int_ {0} ^ {b - a} (b x - x ^ {2} - a x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{6} (b - a) ^ {3}
\]
求 \(\frac{1}{6} (b - a)^3\) 在条件 \(a^2 + b^2 = 1\) 下的最大值.
令 \(L = \frac{1}{6} (b - a)^{3} + \lambda (a^{2} + b^{2} - 1)\)，则
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} L _ {a} ^ {\prime} = - \frac {1}{2} (b - a) ^ {2} + 2 \lambda a = 0 \\ L _ {b} ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{2} (b - a) ^ {2} + 2 \lambda b = 0 \\ L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = a ^ {2} + b ^ {2} - 1 = 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
解得 \(a = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}, b = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\). 故所求面积的最大值为 \(\frac{1}{6}\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)^3 = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{3}\).

questions.stem: 设  \( y = x \cos^{2} x \)  在  \( x \in [0, n\pi] (n = 1, 2, \cdots) \)  上与 x 轴所围图形的面积为  \( S_{n} \) ，则  \( \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{S_{n}}{(n + 1)^{2}} = \)  ____.

solution.analysis_md:
依题设,有
\[
\begin{array}{l} S _ {n} = \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} x \cos^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} x (1 + \cos 2 x) \mathrm{d} x \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} x \mathrm{d} x + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} x \mathrm{d} (\sin 2 x) \right] \\ = \frac {1}{4} n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} + \frac {1}{4} \left[ (x \sin 2 x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {n \pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {n \pi} \sin 2 x \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ = \frac {1}{4} n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{S_n}{(n + 1)^2} = \frac{1}{4}\pi^2.\)

questions.stem: \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\int_0^{2\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin nx\mathrm{d}x =\)

solution.analysis_md:
\(\int_0^{2\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin nx\mathrm{d}x = -\int_0^{2\pi}\sin nx\mathrm{d}(\mathrm{e}^{-x})\)
\[
= - \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \Big | _ {0} ^ {2 \pi} - n \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mathrm{d} x\right)
\]
\[
= - n \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos n x d \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}\right)
\]
\[
= - n \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \left| _ {0} ^ {2 \pi} + n \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \mathrm{d} x\right) \right.
\]
\[
= - n \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \pi} - 1\right) - n ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \mathrm{d} x
\]
第 套参考答案及解析
移项,得  \( \int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin nx\mathrm{d}x=\frac{n(1-\mathrm{e}^{-2\pi})}{1+n^{2}} \)
故 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}n\int_0^{2\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin nx\mathrm{d}x = \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{n^2(1 - \mathrm{e}^{-2\pi})}{1 + n^2} = 1 - \mathrm{e}^{-2\pi}.\)

questions.stem: 设 \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}\) 为线性无关的 3 维列向量, \(A = (\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3})\), 交换 \(A\) 的第 2 列与第 3 列, 再将第 2 列乘以 \((-4)\)、第 3 列乘以 \((-1)\) 得 \(C\), 若 \(BA = C\), 则 \(tr(B) = \_\).

solution.analysis_md:
依题设,有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \boldsymbol {C} = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{r r r} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right] \\ = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \end{array} \right] \\ \end{array}
\]
由  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  线性无关,知  \( \mathbf{A}=(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}) \)  可逆,故
\[
\boldsymbol {B} \boldsymbol {A} = \boldsymbol {C} = \boldsymbol {A} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \end{array} \right] = \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {D}
\]
从而  \( A^{-1}BA = D \) .
由  \( \left|\lambda E - D\right| = \left|\begin{array}{ccc}\lambda - 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & \lambda & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & \lambda\end{array}\right| = (\lambda - 1)(\lambda - 2)(\lambda + 2) \)
得 D 的特征值为 1,2,-2,也是 B 的特征值.
故 \(\operatorname{tr}(\pmb{B}) = 1 + 2 - 2 = 1\).
三、解答题

questions.stem:
设定义在 \((- \infty, + \infty)\) 内的连续函数 \(f(x)\) 满足
\[
f (x) f (y) = f (x + y), \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - f (x)}{x} = 1
\]
求 \(F(x) = |x|f(x)\) 的极值.

solution.analysis_md:
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - f (x)}{x} = - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) - f (0)}{x} = - f ^ {\prime} (0) = 1
\]
即 \(f^{\prime}(0) = -1\) ，故
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) = \lim _ {\Delta x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x + \Delta x) - f (x)}{\Delta x} = \lim _ {\Delta x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (\Delta x) - f (0)}{\Delta x} \cdot f (x) = - f (x)
\]
解微分方程 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f'(x) = -f(x) \\ f(0) = 1 \end{array} \right.\), 得 \(f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\).
\[
F (x) = | x | f (x) = | x | \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - x \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}, & x \leqslant 0 \\ x \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}, & x > 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
\[
F ^ {\prime} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} (x - 1), & x <   0 \\ \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} (1 - x), & x > 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
\[
F _ {-} ^ {\prime} (0) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \frac {- x \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{x} = - 1, \quad F _ {+} ^ {\prime} (0) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {x \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{x} = 1
\]
\( F(x) \)  在 x=0 处不可导. 令  \( F'(x)=0 \) , 得 x=1.
当 \(x < 0\) 时，\(F'(x) < 0\)；当 \(0 < x < 1\) 时，\(F'(x) > 0\)；当 \(x > 1\) 时，\(F'(x) < 0\).
故 \(F(0) = 0\) 为极小值，\(F(1) = \mathrm{e}^{-1}\) 为极大值.

(I) 由 \(x = t^2 (t > 0)\), 得 \(t = \sqrt{x}\), 则
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}\right) = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}\right) \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{4 x} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \\ \end{array}
\]
将 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}, \frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{dx}^2}, \sqrt{x} = t\) 代入原方程，化简得
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} - \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - 6 y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- t} \tag {①}
\]
（Ⅱ）方程 ① 对应的特征方程为  \( r^{2}-r-6=0 \) ，解得  \( r_{1}=-2, r_{2}=3 \) .
令方程 ① 的特解为 \( y^{*} = t^{0} \cdot A e^{-t} \)，则 \( y^{*'} = -A e^{-t} \)，将 \( y^{*''} = A e^{-t} \) 代入方程 ①，可得 \( A = -\frac{1}{4} \).
故方程 ① 的通解为  \( y = C_{1} e^{-2t} + C_{2} e^{3t} - \frac{1}{4} e^{-t} \) .
原方程的通解为 \( y = C_1 \mathrm{e}^{-2\sqrt{x}} + C_2 \mathrm{e}^{3\sqrt{x}} - \frac{1}{4} \mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{x}} \).
由 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}y(x) = 0\) ，得 \(C_1 + C_2 - \frac{1}{4} = 0.\)
由 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}y(x) = 0\) ，得 \(C_2 = 0\) ，故 \(C_1 = \frac{1}{4}, C_2 = 0.\)
所求函数为 \( y(x) = \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-2\sqrt{x}} - \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{x}} \).

(I) \( f'(x) - \frac{1}{n} f(x) = \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)x - 1 - n \) 为一阶线性微分方程.
\[
\begin{array}{l} f (x) = \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{n} \mathrm{d} x} \left\{\int \left[ \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) x - 1 - n \right] \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{n} \mathrm{d} x} \mathrm{d} x + C \right\} \\ = \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {x}{n}} \left\{\int \left[ \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) x - (1 + n) \right] \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x}{n}} \mathrm{d} x + C \right\} \\ = \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {x}{n}} \left\{\left[ - (n + 1) x - n (1 + n) \right] \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x}{n}} - (n + 1) \int \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x}{n}} \mathrm{d} x + C \right\} \\ = - (n + 1) x + C \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {x}{n}} \\ \end{array}
\]
由 \(f(0) = n^2\) ，得 \(C = n^2\) ，故 \(f(x) = n^2\mathrm{e}^{\frac{x}{n}} - (n + 1)x.\)
(Ⅱ) 由  \( f'(x)=ne^{\frac{x}{n}}-(1+n)=0 \)  , 得驻点  \( x=x_{n}=n\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right) \) .
因 \(f''(x) = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{x}{n}} > 0\) ，故 \(x_{n} = n\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)\) 为极小值点.
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} x _ {n} ^ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ \frac {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right)}{\frac {1}{n}} \right] ^ {n} \quad (1 ^ {\infty} \text {型}) = \mathrm{e} ^ {\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \ln \left[ n \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right)\right]}
\]
而 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}n\ln \left[n\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)\right] = \lim_{n\to \infty}n\ln \left[\frac{\ln\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)}{\frac{1}{n}} +1 - 1\right]\)
\[
= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \left[ \frac {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right)}{\frac {1}{n}} - 1 \right] = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) - \frac {1}{n}}{\frac {1}{n ^ {2}}} = - \frac {1}{2}
\]
其中 \(\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right) - \frac{1}{n} = \frac{1}{-2n^2} + o\left(\frac{1}{n^2}\right)(n \to \infty)\).
故原式 \(= \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}\)

questions.stem:
设 \( D=\left\{(r,\theta)\mid0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},0\leqslant r\leqslant2\cos\theta,0\leqslant r\leqslant\frac{2}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\right\} \) .
计算 \(I = \iint_{D} (\cos \theta + \sin \theta) r^{2} d\theta dr.\)

solution.analysis_md:
将极坐标转化为直角坐标.
D 如图中阴影部分所示, 先对 x 积分, 后对 y 积分.
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = \iint_ {D} (\cos \theta + \sin \theta) r ^ {2} \mathrm{d} \theta \mathrm{d} r \\ = \iint_ {D} (x + y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} y \int_ {1 - \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} ^ {2 - y} (x + y) \mathrm{d} x \\ \end{array}
\]
![](/uploads/books/c9d5df1df09b071c1871760f5d99712a47e76ecc3226aaa0ce623b1174c2eac2.jpg)
\[
\begin{array}{l} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + y x\right) \Bigg | _ {1 - \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} ^ {2 - y} d y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ \frac {(2 - y) ^ {2}}{2} + y (2 - y) - \frac {(1 - \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}) ^ {2}}{2} - y (1 - \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}) \right] d y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(y \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} + \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} + 1 - y\right) d y \\ = - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {2}{3} (1 - y ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} + \frac {1}{4} \pi \cdot 1 ^ {2} + 1 - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {2} \right| _ {0} ^ {1} \\ = \frac {1}{3} + \frac {1}{4} \pi + \frac {1}{2} = \frac {5}{6} + \frac {\pi}{4} \\ \end{array}
\]
【注】此题选择先对 y 积分, 后对 x 积分; 或选用极坐标, 但计算量较大.

(I) 当 \(x \in (0,1)\) 时, 由 \(f(x)\) 单调递减, 有
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (0) \mathrm{d} t = x f (0)
\]
令 \(g(x) = \frac{\int_0^x f(t)\mathrm{d}t}{x}\) ，则有
\[
\begin{array}{l} g ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {x f (x) - \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x f (x) - x f (\xi)}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {x [ f (x) - f (\xi) ]}{x ^ {2}} <   0, \quad 0 <   \xi <   x \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(g(x)\) 单调递减，从而有
\[
g (x) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{x} > g (1) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{1}
\]
即 \(x\int_{0}^{1}f(t)\mathrm{d}t <   \int_{0}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t.\)
(Ⅱ) 先证明  \( x_{n} \in (0,1) \) .
当 \(n = 1\) 时，由（I）知
\[
0 \leqslant x _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {1} = \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {0} f (0) \leqslant x _ {0} <   1
\]
假设当 \(n = k\) 时，有 \(x_{k}\in (0,1)\) ，则当 \(n = k + 1\) 时，
\[
0 \leqslant x _ {k} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {k + 1} = \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {k}} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {k} f (0) \leqslant x _ {k} <   1
\]
由数学归纳法,知  \( x_{n} \in (0,1) \) .
由 \(x_{n} = \int_{0}^{x_{n - 1}}f(t)\mathrm{d}t <   x_{n - 1}f(0)\leqslant x_{n - 1}\) ，知 \(\{x_{n}\}\) 单调递减，故 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\) 存在，记 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = a\)
则 \(a \geqslant 0\). 由 \(x_{n} = \int_{0}^{x_{n-1}} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t\), 有 \(a = \int_{0}^{a} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t\).
若 \(a \in (0,1)\), 则 \(a = \int_{0}^{a} f(t) \mathrm{d}t < af(0) \leqslant a\) 矛盾, 故 \(a = 0\), 即 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} x_n = 0\).

(I) 由 \(\sum_{i=1}^{3} a_{ij} = 0\), 知 \(a_{1j} + a_{2j} + a_{3j} = 0 (j = 1, 2, 3)\), 即 \(A\) 的每一列元素之和均为零. 由 \(A\) 是实对称矩阵, 知 \(A\) 的每一行元素之和均为零, 即
\[
\mathbf {A} \left[ \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right] = \mathbf {0} = 0 \left[ \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right]
\]
故 A 有特征值  \( \lambda_{1}=0 \) ，其特征向量  \( \alpha_{1}=(1,1,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
设 A 的二重特征值  \( \lambda_{2}=\lambda_{3}=1 \)  对应的特征向量为  \( \boldsymbol{X}=(x_{1},x_{2},x_{3})^{\mathrm{T}} \) ，由实对称矩阵不同特征值对应的特征向量必正交，有
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} = x _ {1} + x _ {2} + x _ {3} = 0
\]
解得  \( \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(-1,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{3}=(1,1,-2)^{\mathrm{T}} \)  (已正交)，将  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  单位化，有
\[
\boldsymbol {\gamma} _ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (1, 1, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\gamma} _ {2} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (- 1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\gamma} _ {3} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} (1, 1, - 2) ^ {\mathrm{T}}
\]
令 \(Q = (\gamma_{1},\gamma_{2},\gamma_{3}) = \left[ \begin{array}{ccc}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}\\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}\\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & 0 & -\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}} \end{array} \right]\) ，则 \(Q\) 为正交矩阵.
又 \(Q^{-1}AQ = \Lambda = \mathrm{diag}(0,1,1)\) ，故由 \(\mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{A}\mathbf{X}\xlongequal{\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{QY}}0\cdot \mathbf{y}_1^2 +\mathbf{y}_2^2 +\mathbf{y}_3^2 = 0\) ，知
\(y_{1} = C\) ， \(y_{2} = 0\) ， \(y_{3} = 0\) （ \(C\) 为任意常数）
故  \( X = QY = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & 0 & -\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} C \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix} = C \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \end{bmatrix} \) 为方程 \( X^{T}AX = 0 \) 的全部解.
(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知，
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} \xlongequal {\boldsymbol {X} = \boldsymbol {Q Y}} \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {Y} = \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] \boldsymbol {Y} = 2 y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + y _ {3} ^ {2}
\]
令 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}y_{1}&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}z_{1}\\ y_{2}&=z_{2}\\ y_{3}&=z_{3}\end{aligned}\right. \) ，即 \( Y=\begin{bmatrix}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}&0&0\\ 0&1&0\\ 0&0&1\end{bmatrix}Z\xlongequal{记}BZ \) ，则
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} \xlongequal {\boldsymbol {X} = Q B Z} z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + z _ {3} ^ {2}
\]
令 \(P_{1} = QB\) ，则 \(P_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}(2E - A)P_{1} = E\) ，故
\[
2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A} = (\boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1} = (\boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1}
\]
令 \(\pmb {P} = \pmb{P}_{1}^{-1} = (\pmb {Q}\pmb {B})^{-1} = \pmb{B}^{-1}\pmb{Q}^{-1} = \pmb{B}^{-1}\pmb{Q}^{\mathrm{T}}\)
\[
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \sqrt {2} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \\ - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & - \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \\ - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & - \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \end{array} \right]
\]
则 \(X^{\mathrm{T}}(2E - A)X = X^{\mathrm{T}}P^{\mathrm{T}}PX = (PX)^{\mathrm{T}}(PX) = \| PX\|\).
